answer: Sponsorship carries liability: each vouch locks 89 POA behind the newcomer, and the voucher above loses half again if the chain is convicted. Sponsors are capped at 6 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army. The beacon of the cap is the choke point, the prism of the bond is the deterrent, and the falcon of the public chain is the evidence. A farm of 960 aliases must recruit 960 separate sponsors willing to stake real funds on strangers.
